rows.en: “Hey, hold on a second.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh, wait waiiit!"

rows.en: “Yes?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Yes?"

rows.jp: 「ここはあえて、俺と遊ぼうよ」
rows.en: “At a time like this, why don't you hang out with me instead?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I dare you to come play with me, right here, right now!"
ghs.assessment: Taichi deliberately proposes that Miki play with him instead. The English invents a dare and the emphatic constraints 'right here, right now.'
ghs.remedy: Let's do this instead: come play with me.

highlights.text: I dare you to come play with me, right here, right now!

rows.en: Miki stopped dead.

ghs.en: Miki came to a halt.

rows.jp: やはり経験値がない分、反応が鈍い。
rows.en: As expected, without any experience points, she's slow to react.

ghs.en: Expectedly from her low XP status, her responses lack sharpness.

rows.en: “...Just the two of us?”

ghs.en: Miki: "...just... the two of us?"

rows.jp: 「無粋なやつだな。つまりデートに誘ってるんだ」
rows.en: “How unromantic. I'm asking you out on a date.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That was unromantic way of saying it, yeah. In short, I'm inviting you to a date."
ghs.assessment: Taichi calls Miki tactless for explicitly asking whether they will be alone. The English instead characterizes the wording itself as Taichi's unromantic phrasing.

highlights.text: That was unromantic way of saying it

rows.en: “Daaate.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Date."

rows.en: She repeats it for no reason.

ghs.en: Meaninglessly repeating my words.

rows.jp: 「デートに第三者なんぞいらん。二人だけの閉塞した小世界でいい」
rows.en: “A date needs no third wheel. A closed little world for two is all we need.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "We don't need no third wheels on a date. Better a tiny closed world of just the two of us."

rows.en: “I see...”

ghs.en: Miki: "I see..."

rows.jp: 圧倒されて納得したらしい。
rows.en: Apparently overwhelmed, she gave in.

ghs.en: Seems like she's consenting due to being overwhelmed.

rows.en: “I won't take much of your time.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I won't take too much of your time now."

rows.jp: 「というか、霧だってたまには一人になりたい時だってあるだろうさ」
rows.en: “Besides, even Kiri must want time alone once in a while.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Or should I say, every once in a while Kiri would want some time to be alone, I'm sure."

rows.en: “...Okay, then.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...yes, then..."

rows.jp: 「よし、では学校には戻らず団地方向に行こう」
rows.en: “All right. Instead of going back to school, let's head toward the housing complex.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Good. Well then, let's head in the direction of your apartments and not return to school."

rows.jp: 「……あ、でも様子見ておきたいのですが……」
rows.en: “...Ah, but I'd like to check on her...”

ghs.en: Miki: "...ah, but I want to go look at how she's doing..."

rows.en: “Come on, come on.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's fiiine, it's fiiine."

rows.en: “Gnyaaa!”

ghs.en: Miki: "G'nyamyeooow!"

rows.en: I drag her along.

ghs.en: I haul her away.

rows.jp: 今の美希は、一度沈むと取り返しがつかないだろう。
rows.en: The way Miki is now, if she sinks even once, there may be no bringing her back.

ghs.en: Once she sinks into depression, Miki as she is now will likely be unrecoverable.

rows.en: Fragile.

ghs.en: Brittle.

rows.en: But that just means she is normal.

ghs.en: But that's her being normal.

rows.jp: 普通の、女の子ってことだ。
rows.en: An ordinary girl.

ghs.en: It's her being a normal girl.

rows.jp: 不安なんだろう。霧がいなくて。
rows.en: She must be anxious. Kiri isn't around.

ghs.en: Of course she's anxious. Kiri is here no more.

rows.jp: 一週間、気を引ければそれでいい。
rows.en: All I have to do is keep her distracted for a week.

ghs.en: If I can get my hooks into her in this one week, if I can attract her affection, we'll be good.
ghs.assessment: Taichi says it is enough to keep Miki's attention or distract her for a week. The English adds predatory and romantic implications absent from the bounded statement.
ghs.remedy: All I need to do is keep her attention for a week.

rows.en: Then she will return to everyday life.

ghs.en: She will return to her usual life.

rows.jp: けど、ただ送還するだけじゃ意味がない。
rows.en: But there is no point in simply sending her back.

ghs.en: But mere repatriation alone would be meaningless.

rows.jp: 俺が彼女から、多少のものを得る必要があるんだ。
rows.en: I need to get something from her, however small.

ghs.en: I have a need to obtain a little thing or two from her.
